newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Western Australia 103 for two v West Indies.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Western Australia 103 for two v West Indies.

text.p: Western Australia reached 103 for two by lunch on the first day of their three-day match against West Indies on Friday.
Opening batsman Mark Lavender was unbeaten on 34 and shared the crease at the first interval with Damien Martyn, who had scored 32.
Promising pace bowler Patterson Thompson made the initial breakthrough for the tourists when he bowled opener Mike Hussey for four in his second over.
West Indies captain Courtney Walsh later had Justin Langer caught hooking for 18 to bring Lavender and Martyn together.
